title: Code and source data for: Multi-cohort transcriptomics and donor-aware single-cell analyses prioritize S100A8 within an emergency-myeloid, HLA-DR-low state in sepsis
description: Version 2.0.0 aligned with the final revised manuscript PONE-D-26-24904. The archive contains analysis scripts, numerical source data, final supporting tables and figures, donor-aware single-cell summaries, repeat-blocked in vitro statistical outputs, and reproducibility documentation. Raw human transcriptomic data remain available from GEO and SCP548. Redistributed public-data snapshots remain subject to their source repositories' terms; no new rights are asserted over third-party data. The archive does not contain proprietary instrument-native blot acquisition files, which were not present in the available project archive.
